note: Warmth (Dave 2026-10-21: cold costs health, slowly down to 1, like hunger). A vital 0 to 100 shown as the Warmth bar at the top of the inventory and Tab screens only. Each slow tick the server works out the warmth the body is heading for: 100 minus the cold stress. Stress is the degrees below comfort_c (air temperature from the weather and altitude, less wind chill when exposed, plus fire_c near a lit fire), times rain_mult in rain or snow on you, times water_mult when swimming, times gain, cut by the clothing insulation (0 to 0.85; no clothes exist yet, insulation_of is the hook). Warmth moves toward that target with a time constant in game hours (tau_cool falling, tau_warm rising: a fire warms you quicker than the cold chills you). Below cold_at you shiver (exertion rises faster, health stops regenerating); below hurt_at cold costs health hurt_per_s, more the colder, never below 1. Messages use two levels so they do not flicker.
